name: vendor_call
text: A standing market vendor calls out to customers. The right forearm rises beside the mouth as if calling, then the right arm opens forward in a welcoming gesture toward the goods. The left hand remains relaxed near the waist. The feet stay planted and the body stays behind the counter.
